source_entries.note: 1980 original Thatcher illusion report; publisher metadata/abstract
2010 comparisons with multiple non-face object classes
Current historical archive; research claims not converted into cures
Separate promotional full-course offer, dynamic price
Product-specific competent reliable science for health claims

claims.text: Thatcher illusion reported in 1980
claims.limit: report original manipulation; no photo reproduction

claims.text: Orientation can alter recognition of locally inverted features
claims.limit: effect depends on task and stimulus

claims.text: Thatcher effect is unique to human faces
claims.limit: non-face objects also show analogous effect

claims.text: Faces and objects are processed identically
claims.limit: 2010 result does not support complete identity

claims.text: Inverted Thatcherized face relatively improves some expression judgements
claims.limit: task-specific, not general cognitive improvement

claims.text: Thatcherized face affects clinical health
claims.limit: fMRI correlation does not validate treatment

claims.text: Puységur archive has 153 source rows / 16 dossiers
claims.limit: counts read from live page; not psychiatric proof

claims.text: Puységur proves animal magnetism as physical force
claims.limit: historical reports are not independent mechanism
